name: Rollin 80s West Coast Crips
description: The Rollin 80s West Coast Crips originated around the Springdale West Apartment Complex, located on Spring Street and Santa Fe, in the city of Long Beach. They are apart of the Rollin O’s (Crips) and are associated with the Neighborhood Crips (2x).

sources.title: Study on Long Beach Gang Injunction — SF Public Defender
